notes: The tuition evidence quotes a per-semester figure (1,500 EUR per semester); the DAAD page gives it as 'non-EU countries 1,500 EUR' without specifying the period. Documents are not listed per-programme: the DAAD page links to a general checklist but does not name individual documents for this programme, so no documents fact was included. Most documents are stated at institution level, not programme level. Requirement rule 3 references documents process only in the manual_check note. The German A2 mention on the DAAD page is 'required/recommended, no proof required', so treated as manual_check rather than a hard requirement; the B2 German check is also a manual_check because the exact formal admission condition for foreign applicants is not fully stated.
